text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
BARLEY SALE - Iran on Wednesday bought 50,000 tonnes of barley at $127 to $128 per tonne FOB, European grain traders said. The deal has the barley to be shipped in October from optional origins.

WHEAT SALES - The Commodity Credit Corp (CCC) of the U.S. Agriculture Department said it bought 1,750 tonnes of northern spring/dark northern spring wheat for donation to Honduras. It bought the wheat from Continental Grain Co at $165.33 per tonne, FOB. Shipment is for July 10 to August 5.

WHEAT SALES - South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd bought 21,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Mitsui and Co Ltd, a company official said. The deal included 3,700 tonnes of western white/soft white wheat, 1,000 of western white club, 5,000 of hard red winter (11.5 percent protein), and 11,300 of dark northern spring wheat (14 percent). Shipment was for August 20-September 20 to the western port of Inchon. The western white/soft white wheat sold at $140.40, western white club wheat at $141.90, the hard red winter at $146.80, and the dark northern spring at $171.50.

CORN SALE - South Korean buyer group Big Feed Mills bought 52,500 tonnes of U.S. corn at $126.87 a tonne, C&F, from Marubeni Corp, traders said. Shipment was for September 1-20 from the U.S. Gulf, with arrival for October 20 to the western port of Inchon.

VEGOIL SALE - Egypt's state-owned Holding Company for Food Industries said it bought 22,000 tonnes of palm stearin and palm oil of Malaysian or Indonesian origin for August delivery. It bought 15,000 tonnes of palm oil at $534.50 per tonne, C&F, and 7,000 of palm stearin at $416 per tonne, C&F.

WHEAT TENDERS - Results were awaited on Algeria's tender to buy 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat for second half of August and September shipment, U.S. traders said. The wheat can be from the U.S., Canada, Argentina, or the European Union, excluding Britain. Shipment terms include 50,000 tonnes each for LH August, FH September and LH Septmber.
- The CCC said it seeks up to 42,000 tonnes of U.S. no.2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Ethiopia. The shipment period was set for July 15-July 30. Offers were due on June 26.

WHEAT TENDERS - Taiwan Flour Mills Assn on Friday will seek two 33,000-tonne shipments of U.S. wheat, association officials said. One shipment is for July 15 to July 30 delivery from the Pacific Northwest (PNW) and the second for August 5 to 20 from the PNW. The first load includes 21,900 tonnes of dark northern spring, 9,100 hard red winter and 2,000 white wheat. The second includes 19,800 of dark northern spring, 9,000 hard red winter, and 4,200 white wheat.
- The CCC said it seeks July 1 60,000 tonnes of US HRW wheat for July 16-31 shipment for donation to Kyrgyzstan.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan is to tender June 25 for 500,000 tonnes of optional origin white wheat, July 11-August 10 shipment, a spokesman at the country's U.S. embassy in Washington said. He said the wheat would be from the United States, Australia or Canada.

BARLEY TENDERS - Grain traders said on Wednesday a Saudi barley purchase should take shape overnight, but there were already signs that prices could be lower than some had expected. Saudi Arabia, the world's largest barley importer, invited bids on Tuesday to supply one million tonnes of the grain in September and October and has yet to finalise any deals. But traders said prices offered into the tender appeared to suggest lowest offers were worth close to $120 per tonne FOB.
SOYMEAL TENDER - The CCC was scheduled to tender July 2 for 4,560 tonnes of U.S. soymeal for donation to Guatemala. Shipment is for July 17-31.

PALM OIL TENDER - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking 25,000 tonnes of Malaysian and/or Indonesian palm stearin and palm oil for delivery in August. The bid deadline is 0900 GMT on June 25. The oils were in lots of 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin and 15,000 tonnes of palm oil.
